description: Phase 4 MerLin adaptation of E3 with the Table V timing (not the paper's method): hybrid photonic QNN (Linear 64 -> m phases; SQ'/MQ' readout) on m in {6, 8} modes, n in {2, 3} photons, L in {1, 2} re-uploads, UNBUNCHED probabilities; paired with the Phase 3 ANN grid. Same data, folds, training and selection as e3_table_v (default AAPL).
